purpose: Pinned cryptographic identities for every vendor-supplied input that flows into a release artifact. Update only via the documented vendor-update review process (see docs/RUNBOOK.md).

bfw_image.description: Stock BFW local-upgrade image. Pass to build.sh -i.

basic_image_dir.description: Directory containing bootcore.bin, kernel.bin, rootfs.img extracted from stock basic firmware. Pass to build.sh -I.

kernel_blob.description: Vendor-built Linux kernel shipped with the WAS-110. Until a self-built replacement exists, treated as an opaque pinned blob.
kernel_blob.source_status: vendor-only - GPL request open with BFW Solutions / MaxLinear / Calix (see docs/gpl-requests/)
kernel_blob.cve_tracking_status: Linux 4.9 LTS reached EOL 2023-01. Treated as exposed to all post-EOL upstream CVEs unless we receive sources and rebuild. See docs/KERNEL-AUDIT.md.

uboot_blobs.description: U-Boot variants in whole_image/. Vendor-built; no source available locally.

compensating_controls.rootfs_reproducible: build.sh sets SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=GIT_EPOCH and -all-time/-mkfs-time on mksquashfs and mkimage.
compensating_controls.binary_mod_pinning: mods/binary-mods.sh requires expected sha256 hashes before/after every patch.
compensating_controls.vendor_blob_pinning: This file. Verified by pins/verify.sh on every build.
compensating_controls.release_attestation: Each release emits audit/manifest.json with hashes of every input + every output, signed via cosign in the release-build workflow.
